preregistration.registered: OCR v3 pre-registration (judge decision, 2026-09-25), fixed before any v3 template file, glyph distance, prediction, score or negatives run existed; only v2 gate values, segmentation geometry, glyph box sizes and labels were consulted.
preregistration.template_rule: v3 = v2 source plate appearances 1, 2, 9, 18 unchanged plus exactly one added PA: among eval-set plate appearances whose every entry has readability 'readable', all ten field_status 'confirmed', passes the v2 presence gate on the cached frame (navy >= 0.30, top_line mean >= 0.60, panel white <= 0.20) and segments each of the five DIGIT_FIELDS into exactly the label's digit count, take those with labels.inning == 4; prefer the one that also contains a confirmed balls == 3 entry, then the one whose inning glyphs cover the most bounding-box variants seen on the 18 fourth-inning frames (17x10, 16x10, 17x9), then the fewest entries. Result: PA 29 (29/1-5, 29/7). Fallback had no balls-3 PA existed: PA 32. PA 5 is never a source. Templates are cut exactly as in v1/v2 (default segment_glyphs, no options applied at template time); pooled digit->glyph layout, TEMPLATE_SCHEMA sny_digit_templates_v0 and glyph_shape [16,12] kept.
preregistration.reader_options_rule: Stored ONLY in the v3 template document under reader_options and applied ONLY at read time (predict, negatives) by read_scoreboard when the loaded DigitTemplates carries them; a template file without the key (v1, v2) takes the previous code path bit for bit. top_line_gate max_row: bug_present passes the top-line test when the white fraction of ANY single row of the top_line window (rows 32, 33) is >= 0.60 instead of the mean over both rows (targets 11/2 rows 0.204/0.967 and 19/2 rows 0.183/0.967; measured before registration: no other eval or negatives frame has mean < 0.60 with a row >= 0.60). border_sliver_max_width 2: in segment_glyphs a column group of width <= 2 whose first column is 0 or whose last column is the window's last column is discarded before the MIN_GLYPH_WIDTH/HEIGHT tests (targets the 2x26 right-border group at inning-window columns 13-14 at 4/1 and 11/1). No other reader change: probe-edge trimming and per-field-group matching are explicitly NOT part of v3.

code_changed.detail: src/vision/sny_scoreboard.py gained validate_reader_options, top_line_passes, an options argument on bug_present/segment_glyphs/read_number, and DigitTemplates.reader_options (read from / written to the template document only when present); scripts/66 templates gained --reader-options; src/vision/ocr_reports.VERSIONS gained the v3 row and reproduction_commands echoes --reader-options; scripts/70 passes the template file's reader_options through. Defaults reproduce the previous behaviour: scripts/70 for v1 and v2 was run into a scratch --out-dir before and after the code change and the predictions, score and negatives files are byte-identical to the committed ones (outputs/verification/f3c/v12_before, outputs/verification/f3c/v12).

preregistration.evaluation_order: build v3 templates -> predict all 113 -> score --exclude-pas 1 2 9 18 29 -> negatives with v3 -> repeat predict (all by scripts/70 --version v3); v2 predictions re-scored with the same exclusion list for the comparison. Three disjoint blocks: (a) held-out headline = 75 v2-correct pitches (no-regression check, pass = 75 correct / 0 wrong / 0 abstained; any new abstention or wrong field is a v3 regression, never tuned away); (b) seen/diagnosed = 19 fully evaluable pitches with a pixel-diagnosed v2 failure plus the two partial line-score entries, 'first computed after the rule was fixed'; (c) in-sample = the 17 template-source pitches. Negatives: 0 false reads required. No template, option or threshold may be edited after any v3 number is seen; a failed check is reported as a failed v3.
preregistration.blindness: Not blind: every v3 number on the current eval set is 'rule fixed, then first-computed'. Blind evidence for the new '4', count-font '3', score-font '2', gate and sliver behaviour can only come from frames that did not exist at registration (the A-9 inning-5+ decision frames), scored later with the same exclusion list and never merged into the 75.
